scope: Sweep callback allocations in an AC1027 OBJECTS writer containing one locally-authored standalone TABLECONTENT with a single scalar cell.

source.profile: One TABLECONTENT record with a named one-column, one-row grid and a typed UTF-8 scalar value. No external sample or fixture file is used.

implementation.method: Warm and calibrate the OBJECTS callback in ASCII and Binary. Inject std::bad_alloc at every reached callback offset; require export refusal, byte-for-byte destination sentinel preservation, caller model preservation, same-writer retry, and typed fileImport readback of the record and scalar value.

validation.ascii: 12/12 reached callback allocation offsets injected; destination and caller content preserved; same-writer retry and typed grid/value readback passed.
validation.binary: 10/10 reached callback allocation offsets injected; destination and caller content preserved; same-writer retry and typed grid/value readback passed.

limitations: Generated writer transaction and typed-field evidence only; no producer prevalence, native rendering, or feature-semantics claim is established.

The readback retains m_parseComplete but does not report m_semanticContentComplete for this minimal standalone profile; this test does not qualify semantic completeness or strict DXF output eligibility.
This covers one standalone scalar TABLECONTENT shape and does not cover linked data, FIELD references, attributes, custom styles, multi-cell graphs, or source-DXF replay.
nextAction: Continue the P6 allocation audit with another typed OBJECTS writer not yet covered by an allocation rollback/retry receipt; keep FIELD/FIELDLIST strict support gated until the synthetic owner/profile readback refusal is explained.
